title: Tech Note: Preventing Syntax Errors in 4D Expressions When Converting

historical_commentary.text: This note addresses syntax errors that occur when converting databases from 4D v3 to v6, specifically when 4D expressions are embedded in plug-in areas like 4D Write. The solution involves using resources to help 4D interpret expressions correctly during conversion. This is entirely obsolete as the v3-to-v6 conversion path is no longer relevant, and modern 4D uses completely different mechanisms for embedded expressions.
related_updates: 4D v3 to v6 database conversion is no longer a supported migration path
Modern 4D Write Pro has replaced 4D Write with a completely different expression and document model
